idea-plugin.name: OneClickAPI
idea-plugin.description:
OneClickAPI - Generate a complete Spring Boot REST API from an @Entity or POJO class in one click. Free.

Generate complete REST APIs with advanced data management capabilities directly from @Entity-annotated or POJO classes with just clicks. Select multiple classes at once, and generate hundreds or even thousands of APIs in seconds! Key Features: - Automated API generation from JPA Entity or POJO classes - Auto-creation of DTOs, Mappers, Repositories, Services & Controllers - Lombok integration: Automatic annotations and boilerplate reduction - Smart repository method generation (JPA/Custom implementations) - Clean architecture enforcement with proper package structure - File Upload APIs: Built-in PDF/Image upload endpoints generation - Liquibase integration: Automated database schema management - Enhanced Service Layer architecture for business logic isolation - Robust exception handling: Auto-generated global error controllers - **Multi-Class Selection:** Select hundreds of classes and generate thousands of APIs instantly - **MyBatis Support:** Generate APIs from simple POJO classes in addition to @Entity classes - **Liquibase Support:** Generate database changelogs in YAML or XML - **Advanced Global Exception Handling:** Automatically handles and customizes error responses - **File Upload API Support:** Instantly generate APIs for PDF and image uploads - **Clean Code & Best Practices:** Automatically follows clean architecture principles, ensuring readable, maintainable code How It Works: 1. Install plugin and right-click any @Entity or POJO class 2. Select "Generate API" from context menu 3. Configure options (enable file upload support, etc.) 4. Get production-ready APIs in seconds! Why Choose OneClickAPI: - 80% faster API development cycle - Enterprise-grade code quality out of the box - Future-proof architecture patterns - Customizable templates for special requirements - Seamless file handling capabilities - Reduced maintenance overhead - **Highly customizable:** Ability to tweak templates and adjust generated code based on project needs - **Boosted productivity:** Simplifies complex tasks, letting developers focus on business logic instead of boilerplate code
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 - First public release as OneClickAPI: free, multi-class selection, JPA and MyBatis, Liquibase (XML/YAML), file upload APIs, global exception handling.
